audience: pool and spa service companies that run routes, jobs, invoices and customer records in Pool Brain

useCases.title: Find customers with open alerts on their pools
useCases.text: List the alerts on jobs and check which ones are not dismissed. Search for the customers involved and read their contact details and service history.

useCases.title: Review the route stop jobs for a week
useCases.text: List the jobs on route stops within a date range. Open one job to read its chemical readings and chemical status.

useCases.title: Review technician routes and technician pay
useCases.text: Read the technician routes for one day or a date range, with their stops and schedules. Read the pay and payment history of the technicians for the same period.

useCases.title: Show invoices with a balance due and recent payments
useCases.text: List invoices with their balance due and dates. Read the product details of one invoice, then list the payments to see what came in.

useCases.title: Add a note to a customer record
useCases.text: Search for the customer, then add a note to the record, for example that the gate code changed. Read the customer notes later to check the change.

useCases.title: Create a customer and update the details later
useCases.text: Create a customer with contact, address and water body details. Update the contact or address details of the customer when they change.
